DK25.0 is a specific medical diagnosis code representing an acute gastric ulcer with bleeding ("akut mavesår med blødning") [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system, this code plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment complications, specifically for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. It is one of the designated codes used to calculate the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among this patient population, serving as a key metric in the national quality indicators managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src3].

The code is part of a broader, standardized set of diagnostic classifications used to monitor bleeding complications in atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. When evaluating the incidence of severe bleeding, healthcare registries utilize a wide array of diagnosis codes spanning intracranial bleeds (e.g., [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds064|DS064]], [[ds065|DS065]], [[ds066|DS066]]), gastrointestinal bleeds, and respiratory or urinary tract bleeds (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. For gastrointestinal bleeding specifically, DK25.0 is grouped alongside other ulcer and gastric codes (such as [[dk25-2|DK25.2]], [[dk25-4|DK25.4]], [[dk25-6|DK25.6]], [[dk26-0|DK26.0]], [[dk26-2|DK26.2]], [[dk26-4|DK26.4]], [[dk26-6|DK26.6]], [[dk27-0|DK27.0]], [[dk27-2|DK27.2]], [[dk27-4|DK27.4]], [[dk27-6|DK27.6]], [[dk28-0|DK28.0]], [[dk28-2|DK28.2]], [[dk28-4|DK28.4]], [[dk28-6|DK28.6]], [[dk29-0|DK29.0]], [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], [[dk92-0|DK92.0]], [[dk92-1|DK92.1]], and [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]) to ensure comprehensive capture of adverse events [^src1]. This rigorous coding methodology is consistently documented across multiple annual reports of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), including the 2023, 2024, and 2025 editions, highlighting its ongoing importance in national cardiovascular quality assurance [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

## Claims
- **Diagnostic:** For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
